result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer receives a 30-day convenience-termination right and a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, while Vendor has no corresponding right during a term. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” unnecessarily creates a partial-service termination right that may disrupt agreed scope and pricing beyond the playbook requirement. Otherwise, the language is clear and professionally drafted.
